deck.title: Jesus in One Minute
deck.subtitle: A short English presentation for a final speech
deck.author: Codex

slides.title: Jesus is the central figure of Christianity.
slides.subtitle: A one-minute introduction to who he is, what he taught, and why he still matters.
slides.note: Short, clear, and easy to present without reading.

slides.title: Jesus is both a historical person and the heart of Christian faith.
bullets: He lived in the land of Palestine about two thousand years ago.
Christians believe he is the Son of God and the Savior.
His life and teachings are recorded in the New Testament.
slides.asideText: In history he is Jesus of Nazareth; in faith he is Christ, the one sent to save humanity.

slides.title: The message of Jesus can be remembered in three simple words.
slides.takeaway: His teaching centers on love, forgiveness, and salvation.

metrics.label: Core value
metrics.note: Love God and love other people.

metrics.label: Religious meaning
metrics.note: Christians believe he brings hope and redemption.

slides.title: Jesus shaped not only a religion, but also world history and culture.
slides.message: Even today, Christianity remains one of the world's most influential religions, and Jesus remains its center.
